name: all seasons Jakarta Thamrin
short_description: A 166-room hotel on Jalan Talang Betutu just off the Thamrin corridor, steps from Sudirman Baru (BNI City) station and about 1.2km from Grand Indonesia.
ai_summary: all seasons Jakarta Thamrin sits on Jalan Talang Betutu, a side street just off the Sudirman-Thamrin business corridor, a few minutes' walk from Sudirman Baru (BNI City) railway station and roughly 1.2km from Grand Indonesia mall. The 166-room property includes 10 Junior Suites with skyline views, and its rooftop Skyloft Restaurant serves a buffet breakfast with city views. Guests consistently praise the central, transit-friendly location and friendly, helpful staff, with breakfast and cleanliness also drawing regular compliments, while some reviews note compact bathrooms, occasional service inconsistency, and construction noise from the surrounding fast-developing block. It functions well as a value-oriented base for business travelers and shoppers wanting easy access to Jakarta's Golden Triangle without paying upscale rates.

faqs.question: How many rooms does all seasons Jakarta Thamrin have?
faqs.answer: The hotel has 166 rooms in total, including 10 Junior Suites that offer skyline views over central Jakarta. Standard rooms are air-conditioned with a flat-screen TV, safe, and private bathroom, positioning the property as a value-focused option in the Thamrin-Sudirman business corridor.

faqs.question: Is all seasons Jakarta Thamrin close to public transport?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits a short walk from Sudirman Baru (BNI City) station, which serves the airport rail link and connects to Jakarta's MRT network, and it is roughly 1.2km from Grand Indonesia and 1.5km from Plaza Indonesia, making it convenient for both business travel and shopping trips.

faqs.question: Does all seasons Jakarta Thamrin have a rooftop restaurant?
faqs.answer: Yes -- Skyloft Restaurant sits on the hotel's upper floor and serves an all-day menu plus a buffet breakfast with views over the surrounding Thamrin skyline, and it is one of the most consistently praised features in guest reviews of the property.

reviews.title: All Seasons Jakarta Thamrin Review
reviews.summary: Well-managed mid-range hotel with friendly, knowledgeable staff and functional rooms. Construction noise nearby is a drawback, but the rooftop terrace and good internet compensate for the price.
